channel.title: Match of the Day
channel.desc: Kelly Cates presents highlights from eight Premier League games. At the top of the table, Arsenal take on Sunderland, Aston Villa travel to Bournemouth, whilst Manchester United face Tottenham in the day's early game. At the bottom of the table, there's a massive game between Burnley and West Ham, and Leeds welcome Nottingham Forest to Elland Road on Friday night. Elsewhere, Fulham play Everton, Chelsea make the journey to Wolves, and it's Newcastle versus Brentford in the day's late game.
